hero.bio: I'm Rahul — a freelance filmmaker & editor based out of Delhi, working with studios and founders worldwide. Stories cut with rhythm, light and intent.

about.title: A few words
about.bio1: I'm a filmmaker & editor obsessed with rhythm, light, and the small moments that make a story breathe. Over the last ten years I've cut campaigns for brands, directed short documentaries and helped founders turn raw footage into stories people share.
about.bio2: When I'm not editing, I'm usually on a flight somewhere remote, reading scripts, or riding my bike very slowly uphill.

services.title: Video Editing
services.desc: Story-first cuts for long-form documentaries, brand films and YouTube.

services.title: Color Grading
services.desc: Cinematic, naturalistic grades in DaVinci Resolve with custom LUTs.

services.title: Motion Design
services.desc: Type, transitions and 2D animation in After Effects & Cinema 4D.

services.title: Direction
services.desc: Concept-to-screen creative direction for commercials and short films.

services.title: Sound & Mix
services.desc: Sound design, dialogue cleanup and final mix in Pro Tools.
